name: RuleStone decision
description: Evaluates a RuleStone decision table: versioned, effective-dated rules with exact decimals.

groups.label: Result
groups.tooltip: The job completes with one variable holding output, reasonCodes, matchedRules, ruleVersion and matched. Without output mappings it is merged into the process scope; add an output mapping, e.g. source =decision.output.decision, target loanDecision, to narrow it.

properties.label: Decision ID
properties.description: The id of the decision table, e.g. loan_eligibility.

pattern.message: Starts with a letter; letters, digits, '_', '.' and '-'.

properties.label: Version
properties.description: An exact version label, for replays and investigations. Leave empty to use the version effective on the business date.

properties.label: As-of date variable
properties.description: Name of a process variable holding the business date as "yyyy-MM-dd", e.g. the application date. Leave empty to use today according to the worker's clock.

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Variable the result is written to. Decimals, money and dates in it are strings; compare decimals with number(...) in FEEL.

properties.label: Fail when no rule matches
properties.description: Throw the BPMN error below when no rule matches, instead of completing with matched = false.

properties.label: BPMN error code
properties.description: Thrown when the decision cannot be evaluated (invalid or missing input, a failing rule) and, if enabled, when no rule matches. Catch it with an error boundary event. A missing decision raises an incident instead.

properties.label: Job type
properties.description: The job type the RuleStone worker subscribes to.

properties.label: Retries
properties.description: Attempts after an unexpected worker failure. Evaluation errors and missing decisions are never retried.
